lock_viewer.note: Digest over exact ordered entry/feedback event records,including times,actor,text and attachment refs/hashes.

rank.note: Exactly one complete strict ranking per predeclared judge;raw report preserved.

lock_judge.note: Every predeclared judge ranks before lock;no post-reveal judge selection.

reveal.note: Exact committed preimage required;full pool/assets and previous locks revalidated.

schemas.judge_public_transcript_lock: source_digest anchors original private lock;packet_digest hashes domain-separated canonical public transcript,without exposing private chain/paths. Transfer and independently retain anchors;owner can still recompute both.
schemas.report: Public before reveal contains only profile,cue,origin,state,commitment and limitations. Private after reveal/terminal includes exact trial,full history,roles,rights,locks and each judge result. Blind packets never embed private requests.

rights_policy: PNG only:signature,CRC,exact IHDR/one IDAT/IEND;8bit RGB,noninterlaced,filter0,correct bounded decoded byte length,no trailing bytes/no ancillary chunks. All5dimensions equal. Reject unsupported metadata-bearing files;no automatic sanitizer or semantic leak guarantee. Transfer only fresh alias.png files and packet.json;never copy source dirs/sidecars.

assignment.os_uniform: Private secrets.token_bytes one-byte draws;reject250..255;accepted byte modulo5;record all draws privately. Nonce secrets.token_hex32. OS-origin is not independently attestable from files.
assignment.simulated_seed: Only origin simulated. SHA256 UTF8(seed)+ASCII(counter),first byte;reject250..255. Nonce SHA256(UTF8(seed)+ASCII nonce). Public seeds never qualify as concealed human randomization.
assignment.manual: Explicit target ID, no uniform or chance-qualified designation;private OS nonce. Human means user-declared record origin, not verified human participation.

randomization_and_commitment.canonical: Sorted-key compact JSON;ensure_ascii=false;allow_nan=false;UTF8;no terminal newline. Digests SHA256. Raw text values unchanged;no Unicode or whitespace normalization.
randomization_and_commitment.limitations: Nonce supports computational concealment under stated assumptions;entropy source,identity and prior publication cannot be proved from files alone. Synthetic seeds are labeled andnever chance-qualified human randomization.

chronology_and_roles.policy: Accepted event times strictly increase after plan.created_at. Original strings and rejected attempts retained. Invalid action produces hashed rejected event with attempted payload and reason;state remains unchanged. Replay recomputes failure reason. A rejected command does not imply target was disclosed;any actual exposure must terminate leaked. Terminal state cannot restart.
chronology_and_roles.participant_separation: All tasker/viewer/monitor/judge IDs distinct. Blind mode requires unaware declarations. Shared filesystem is ineligible for declared participant-blinded scoring. Independently witnessed always false.
chronology_and_roles.training: Documentary feedback mode retained with explicit unblinded status andno eligible blind scoring.
chronology_and_roles.lock_policy: Exact text/attachment/event digests;replay recomputes decisions and locks. No in-place amendment preserving original lock. Rejected requests against a trusted valid trial return updated private history even on CLIexit2;caller must persist it. Corrupt or incomplete root requests cannot amend an untrusted artifact.

scoring.metric: Every predeclared judge’s actual target rank1..5 after authorized reveal;rank1 boolean andfull strict ranking retained. Ties rejected.
scoring.summary: Complete predeclared trial IDs required. Allstatecounts andfailures retained;metrics per judge,not best judge selection. Asset reuse forbidden or explicitly dependent. Manual,simulated,unblinded andunknown/dependent trials never receive unsupported uniform human randomization certification.
scoring.inference: No p-values. No objective resemblance score,ESP score or paranormal cause inferred.

verification.qualification: Synthetic mathematical/procedural checks only;no real participant experiment or ESP validation.

replay.qualification: Published demo is simulated. Human-origin/manual example demonstrates a declared input schema,not verified participation or empirical performance. Actual exports and bytes checked;no private preimage in blind packets.
replay.protocol: Canonical UTF8 values,no Unicode/whitespace normalization;report hash domain-separated. Markdown contains exact result JSON,never a hidden private request in a public packet.
